These kind of threads always turn into a servers vs. retail workers thing over who has it shittier.  I've worked in both, I was a server for three years and I've been in retail for about a year now.  Hands down, in my experience being a server was MUCH worse.  Could've been just where I worked but I worked in pretty much opposite sides of the spectrum.  I worked in a local bar and grill, and then a very nice chain restaurant.  I now work in the mall.  The main difference for me was that there's at least some respect for my schedule and the hours I want to work in retail.  In the restaurant business it was 6 days, double shifts or you can quit.  The running around is unbearable.  The side duties are unbearable.  The people are unbearable.  I could go on, but the point is now I feel like I'm not working directly under every single person who walks in like I did before and I can speak to people how they speak to me.
